resources.string:
Pixel IMS %1$s

Activate selected carrier settings without root or Shizuku. The guardian can restore them after developer options are turned off. Reboot, force-stop or loss of authorization requires a new session.

NR and 5G+ settings control eligibility and display policy; actual aggregation and network availability depend on your carrier and modem.
Request not confirmed. Check the connection and try again.
Stop the guardian and clear temporary carrier overrides for active SIMs? Another authorization is needed to start protection again.
Developer options and debugging are off. Configuration recovery remains active.
Developer options or debugging are on. Configuration recovery remains active.
Choose your settings, then authorize once to apply them.
Make carrier voice calls over LTE. Availability still depends on carrier support and provisioning.
Expose voice calling over standalone 5G where supported. This does not force the modem to use 5G SA.
Allow carrier calls over Wi-Fi when supported by your account and network.
Allow both NSA and SA in carrier configuration. Actual aggregation and available bands depend on the network and modem.
Requires 5G NR. Uses the existing NR Advanced bandwidth and band policy. The system decides when to display the icon; it does not force 5G-Advanced connectivity.
Allow Wi-Fi calling while roaming, subject to carrier policy and possible charges.
Expose supplementary services such as call forwarding and call waiting over IMS.
Show IMS status in system settings
Allow the system SIM settings to show IMS registration status.
Allow calls on one SIM using the other SIM data connection when supported.
Expose adding APNs in system settings. It does not create or change an APN automatically.
These are your saved choices. Pause the guardian to edit them.
The guardian does not need an ongoing ADB connection. Open this only to authorize a new session.
Temporarily connect to Wi-Fi and enable wireless debugging. Pair once, then return to apply your settings.
Not connected. Check debugging or pair again.
